newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Hungary envoy to Ethiopia, Kenya on downed plane.
newsitem.headline: Hungary envoy to Ethiopia, Kenya on downed plane.

text.p: Hungary's ambassador to Ethiopia and Kenya was among the passengers on the hijacked Ethiopian Airlines plane that crashed off the Comoro Islands on Saturday, diplomats told Reuters.
The diplomat was returning to Nairobi after presenting his credentials to Ethiopian President Negasso Gidada on Thursday.
At least 50 people were killed in the accident in which 45 others were pulled out alive.

The Boeing 767 was carrying 163 passengers and 12 crew when it was hijacked after taking off from Addis Ababa en route to its first scheduled stop in the Kenyan capital Nairobi. The plane ran out of fuel and ditched into the sea while trying to land at Moroni airport on the Comoro Islands.
